meta.title: SF Late Night
meta.origin: 21st Ave & Judah St, San Francisco, CA 94122
meta.threshold: Open past 11:00 PM on Friday, Saturday, or Sunday
meta.scopeNote: Static, source-linked directory. Hours are transcribed from each venue's official site; the site does not claim live availability.
meta.transitNote: Transit labels are screening notes, not turn-by-turn directions. Use the live route link and check SFMTA/BART service before leaving.

venues.name: Emporium SF

access.detail: Use the live route link for the last mile; Divisadero is served by Muni connections from the N Judah corridor.

source.quote: 616 Divisadero St. San Francisco, California 94117. General Hours: Monday 4PM-2AM; Tuesday 4PM-2AM; Wednesday 4PM-2AM; Thursday 4PM-2AM; Friday 4PM-2AM; Saturday 2PM-2AM; Sunday 2PM-2AM.

venues.name: Zeitgeist

access.detail: Use a live planner to compare N Judah plus a walk with the 16th St BART / Mission bus corridor.

source.quote: Zeitgeist is a German Beergarden ... located at 199 Valencia Street, San Francisco, CA 94103. Mon 2 PM–11 PM; Tues 2 PM–11 PM; Wed 2 PM–11 PM; Thurs 2 PM–12 AM; Fri 2 PM–1 AM; Sat 12 PM–1 AM; Sun 11 AM–9:30 PM.

venues.name: Make-Out Room
venues.address: 3225 22nd St at Mission, San Francisco, CA 94110

access.detail: The venue's own directions name BART 24th & Mission and the #49/#14 Mission buses stopping on Mission at 22nd Street.

source.label: Official contact and directions page
source.quote: MAKE OUT ROOM, 3225 22nd Street @ Mission, San Francisco, California 94110. OPEN 6pm–2am Tuesday–Saturday; 6pm–2am Sunday (plus occasional matinee shows Noon–5pm); Closed Monday. Walking: BART 24th & Mission Street Station; #49 & #14 Mission buses stop on Mission at 22nd Street.

flags: Strictly 21+; occasional matinees are separately noted by the venue.

verification.method: Official page checked line by line for name, address, hours, and transit note; all three requested weekend days end after 11 PM.

venues.name: Specs' Twelve Adler Museum Cafe
venues.address: 12 William Saroyan Place, San Francisco, CA 94133

access.detail: Plan a live Muni route via the Columbus/Grant North Beach corridor, then walk the final block(s).

venues.name: Casements Bar

access.detail: Mission Street location; check a live planner for 24th St BART or Mission bus service and the last-mile walk.

source.quote: Casements Bar, 2351 Mission Street, San Francisco, CA 94110. Mon 4pm–2am; Tue 4pm–2am; Wed 4pm–2am; Thu 4pm–2am; Fri 3pm–2am; Sat 2pm–2am; Sun 2pm–2am.

venues.name: The Mint Karaoke Lounge

access.detail: Use the live planner for N Judah/Muni Metro or BART plus a walk; the venue is on Market Street.

source.quote: Same-day reservations by phone only ... Hours: Mon-Fri 5PM-2AM; Sat-Sun 4PM-2AM; Tues: Available for private events only. Contact info: 1942 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94102.

venues.name: Pilsner Inn

access.summary: Church St Muni / N Judah + short walk
access.detail: The venue identifies itself at the Castro, Mission, and Duboce Triangle intersection; use the live planner for Church St Muni/N Judah connections.

source.label: Official site and location page
source.quote: 225 Church Street, San Francisco, CA 94114. The official location listing states 1:00p–2:00a Monday–Thursday and 12:00p–2:00a Friday–Sunday; the current home page also states open until 2AM.

flags: The current home page emphasizes the closing time rather than repeating the full weekly table; the location-page schedule is retained here for review.

verification.method: Official site checked for address and late closing; location schedule and home-page closing statement agree on 2 AM.
